findings.label: Error-boundary teardown flake
findings.detail: On 1 of 2 reviewer runs of `CI=1 pnpm --filter web test:e2e`, apps/web/e2e/error-boundary.spec.ts afterAll (line 59) timed out after 15 s waiting for port 3101 to stop answering after SIGTERM (81 passed, 1 failed, exit 1). The second run passed 82/82, and afterwards nothing was listening on 3100/3101/4100/4101. The spec is unchanged since Phase 5 (pre-existing, not a Phase 6 regression), and docs/phase6-verification.md does not mention it.
findings.action: Before Phase 7 CI: raise the afterAll poll timeout or send SIGKILL after a grace period, and record the flake in the evidence file.
